name: Login Look Customizer
author: Maulik Patel

sections.description:
Login Look Customizer allows you to effortlessly personalize the WordPress login screen to match your brand identity. Whether you’re building client websites or branding your own, this plugin enables you to customize the WordPress login page — change logo, background color or image, form styling, buttons, and now even protect your login with Google reCAPTCHA.

Key Features:

  • Upload and display a custom logo on the login page.
  • Change login form background color or add a background image.
  • Customize login button colors and hover effects.
  • Modify link colors and font styles.
  • Toggle design features on/off easily.
  • Add Google reCAPTCHA to secure your login page.
  • Lightweight, fast, and fully compatible with WordPress standards.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/login-look-customizer.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Settings > Login Look Customizer to configure plugin options.
sections.faq:
Will this plugin affect my website frontend?

No. This plugin only customizes the WordPress login page (wp-login.php).

Can I use a transparent logo image?

Yes, PNG format logos with transparency are fully supported.

Is reCAPTCHA optional?

Yes, reCAPTCHA can be enabled or disabled from the plugin settings page.

Will it work with caching plugins?

Yes, it works well with most caching plugins. Just clear your cache after saving changes.

How do I reset all settings?

Simply remove or reset the values on the plugin settings page and click save.
